The '''Kvabja system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Uoti sector/Legends|Uoti sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kvabja]].
